Often. Tell us when you book that you are coming from Koroit and we will plan the appointments with the drive in mind.

For many patients, yes — it stops on our street. If you are having anything more involved than routine care, arrange a lift home.

Of course. {{#preOpening}}We will see people from across the Moyne Shire and the surrounding districts.{{/preOpening}}{{^preOpening}}We see people from across the Moyne Shire and the surrounding districts.{{/preOpening}}

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Koroit sits on the northern rim of Tower Hill, about seventeen kilometres north-west of Warrnambool, and the run into town takes around a quarter of an hour.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Small towns tend to value the same thing in a dentist: knowing who you are going to see. Dr Meg spent close to ten years in regional Western Australia watching patients handed between dentists as staff turned over,

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Appointments are scheduled with enough time to do the work properly, which matters more when you have driven in for it. Where a longer visit can save you a second trip, we will try to arrange it that way.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ready to book? Give us a call on {{phone}}. You would be very welcome.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Getting to us

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Driving — head south-east from Koroit and join the Princes Highway toward town. It becomes Raglan Parade on the outskirts; turn into the CBD and make for Lava Street, one block north of Koroit Street. Roughly seventeen kilometres, about fifteen minutes.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bus — worth knowing about. Services run between Koroit and Warrnambool several times a day and terminate at the Lava Street Interchange, on our street. Check current timetables with Public Transport Victoria.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Parking — the Warrnambool Shopping Centre undercover car park is closest, entered from Lava Street or Koroit Street. Ozone, Parkers and the Coles–Younger car parks are nearby, and Banyan Street usually has free on-street parking within the posted limits. Street parking near the practice is paid, and the shopping centre car park is free for two hours.
